name: claude-au-startup-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for starting a business in Australia. Plugin: aussie-startup-kit. Included skills: [pty-ltd-incorporation-au] Guides a founder through registering an Australian Pty Ltd to obtain an ACN and ABN: onboarding questions, a document generator (constitution, incorporation pack, post-registration pack) with placeholder-only templates, and Google Drive, Linear and Slack workflows. General drafts only, not legal advice.
